result.summary: Splits the monolithic `test_IsStandard` unit test in `src/test/transaction_tests.cpp` into distinct test cases for each policy rule. Replaces mutable static globals (`g_dust`, `g_bare_multi`) with an explicit `StandardPolicy` struct passed to test helpers, ensuring each test case constructs its own transaction and runs in isolation.
result.problem: Tests for standard transaction rules previously shared and mutated a single transaction object sequentially while modifying global policy variables. This coupled independent checks, risked accidental state leakage between test assertions, and made test failures harder to isolate.
evidence: PR description links to tracking issue #36692 ('Declarative construction of test data') as part of an effort to clean up test data setup.
result.changed_since_previous: No substantial changes to the approach or scope; the implementation matches the earlier description.
result.card: Splits the monolithic test_IsStandard unit test into independent test cases for each policy rule. It replaces mutable global variables like g_dust and g_bare_multi with an explicit StandardPolicy struct and constructs fresh transaction fixtures for each check to prevent cross-test state leakage. This is a developer-facing test cleanup supporting issue #36692 without behavioral changes to node validation or policy logic.

risk.why: A mistake would only cause unit test failures or false test passes without affecting node runtime behavior.
